name: elian-workflow
description: Issue-cycle bookends that record engineering work history to Notion: open an issue (validate branch upstream, move the task to in-progress, seed the history skeleton) and close it (interview for decisions and trade-offs, upsert a readable narrative, backfill unrecorded commits, transition status, render a before/after viewer). Workspace-agnostic — every database id, property name, and status value comes from a local config file the skill helps you create on first run.
